# New
* Added a Confirmation function when augmenting Ambuscade Capes where Alexandria will wait until the user confirms the stats were correct before proceeding.

# Bugfixes

* Fixed a bug where the blacklist button on Net Worth could sometimes become unreachable in some scenarios.
